Union Minister Honours Earth Science Olympiad Winners, India Secures 9 Medals

Union Minister Jitendra Singh felicitated the winners of the International Earth Science Olympiad 2026. India secured a total of nine medals at the competition. The Ministry of Earth Sciences stated that the minister emphasized the government's dedication to empowering youth through student-focused outreach programs and fostering a foundational scientific temperament.
